title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise as investors await historic SpaceX IPO
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货上涨，投资者等待历史性的 SpaceX 首次公开募股
summary: US stock futures rose as Wall Street geared up for SpaceX’s market debut and welcomed easing tensions between the US and Iran.
summary_zh: 随着华尔街为 SpaceX 的上市做准备，并欢迎美国和伊朗之间紧张局势的缓和，美国股指期货上涨。

title: Expect 'robust capability' from this KKR-backed AI venture: CEO
title_zh: 首席执行官：期待 KKR 支持的人工智能企业拥有“强大的能力”
summary: A group led by investment firm KKR (KKR) is devoting $10 billion into a new AI data center venture, Helix Digital Infrastructure, headed by former Amazon Web Services (AMZN) CEO Adam Selipsky.
summary_zh: 由投资公司 KKR (KKR) 领导的集团正在向一家新的人工智能数据中心企业 Helix Digital Infrastructure 投入 100 亿美元，该企业由前亚马逊网络服务 (AMZN) 首席执行官 Adam Selipsky 领导。

title: SpaceX takes unconventional route to pricing its stock ahead of IPO
title_zh: SpaceX 在 IPO 前采取非常规方式对其股票定价
summary: It's SpaceX IPO Eve (SPAX.PVT) and Elon Musk's space company is setting its IPO price on Thursday night, taking an alternate route to offer stock at $135 per share rather than a general range.
summary_zh: SpaceX IPO 前夕 (SPAX.PVT) 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的太空公司将于周四晚设定 IPO 价格，采取另一种方式以每股 135 美元而非一般价格发行股票。

title: Why Elon Musk is the 'king of big ideas'
title_zh: 为什么埃隆·马斯克是“大创意之王”
summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) is on the launchpad, just one day away from its scheduled IPO.
summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 已登上发射台，距离预定的首次公开募股 (IPO) 仅剩一天。

title: Siri upgrades show promise, but questions remain
title_zh: Siri 升级显示出希望，但问题仍然存在
summary: Fresh off Apple’s (AAPL) WWDC, Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination to break down the highlights and shortcomings of Apple’s latest announcement, including a closer look at the company’s upgraded Siri AI.
summary_zh: 刚刚结束苹果 (AAPL) WWDC 的雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 与乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 一起探讨了市场统治地位，详细分析了苹果最新公告的亮点和缺点，包括仔细研究了该公司升级后的 Siri AI。

title: How Navan gained market share and climbed back to its IPO price
title_zh: Navan 如何获得市场份额并回升至 IPO 价格
summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi welcomes Navan (NAVN) CEO Ariel Cohen to discuss the company's earnings beat and increased full-year guidance.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经执行编辑布莱恩·索齐 (Brian Sozzi) 欢迎 Navan (NAVN) 首席执行官阿里尔·科恩 (Ariel Cohen) 讨论该公司的盈利增长和提高的全年指引。

title: Oracle stock sinking as its AI spending climbs, debt grows
title_zh: 随着人工智能支出攀升和债务增长，甲骨文股价下跌
summary: Oracle (ORCL) stock has dropped by as much as 10% in Thursday's pre-market trading despite topping fiscal fourth quarter earnings and revenue estimates.
summary_zh: 尽管第四财季盈利和收入超出预期，甲骨文 (ORCL) 股价在周四盘前交易中仍下跌了 10%。

title: SpaceX sets $135 IPO price ahead of Friday Nasdaq debut
title_zh: SpaceX 在周五纳斯达克上市前设定 135 美元的 IPO 价格
summary: SpaceX's priced its IPO Thursday night ahead at $135 a share ahead of the stock's debut on the Nasdaq on Friday, June 12.
summary_zh: SpaceX 在 6 月 12 日星期五在纳斯达克上市之前，于周四晚间将其 IPO 定价为每股 135 美元。

title: 'Magnificent 7' stocks have lost $2 trillion so far this month, driving the S&P 500 decline: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 本月迄今为止，“Magnificent 7”股票已损失 2 万亿美元，推动标准普尔 500 指数下跌：每日图表
summary: The group has erased roughly $1.8 trillion in market value this month, while the rest of the S&P 500 is still holding up.
summary_zh: 该集团本月市值蒸发了约 1.8 万亿美元，而标准普尔 500 指数的其他成分股仍然坚挺。
